s.zh: 1.134.0：建筑「探索公告板」（杂项，木材或石料 50）每几天贴出 3 条委托（清剿怪物巢穴、讨伐通缉犯、救援被困冒险者、寻回失物、调查闹鬼废墟），显示推荐等级和危险度；接下后世界地图上出现地点，7 天内完成。关闭后不再刷新，已接的照常进行。
s.en: 1.134.0: the building "adventurers' notice board" (Misc, 50 wood or stone) posts 3 jobs every few days (clear monster lairs, hunt outlaws, rescue trapped adventurers, recover lost items, investigate haunted ruins), showing recommended level and danger; once accepted, a site appears on the world map, to be completed within 7 days. When off, it stops refreshing; accepted jobs continue as usual.
